title: Director Customer Programs and Solutions - Customer Policy & Solutions - Akron FirstEnergy Headquarters
description:
**FirstEnergy at a Glance**

We are a forward-thinking electric utility powered by a diverse team of employees committed to making customers’ lives brighter, the environment better and our communities stronger.

FirstEnergy (NYSE: FE) is dedicated to integrity, safety, reliability and operational excellence. Headquartered in Akron, Ohio, FirstEnergy includes one of the nation's largest investor-owned electric systems, more than 24,000 miles of transmission lines that connect the Midwest and Mid-Atlantic regions, and a regulated generating fleet with a total capacity of more than 3,500 megawatts.

**About the Opportunity**

This is an open position with FirstEnergy Service Company, a subsidiary of FirstEnergy Corp.

This is a full-time, on-site position located in one of the FirstEnergy locations in: Akron, OH; Greensburg, PA, Reading, PA; Holmdel, NJ, Fairmont, WV and Frederick, MD.

This position is within the FE Pennsylvania organization and reports to the President, FE Pennsylvania.

**Key responsibilities include:**

Strategic Leadership

* Develop and execute FirstEnergy's enterprise strategy for customer programs, distributed energy resources (DERs), electrification, virtual power plants (VPPs), demand flexibility, and emerging customer energy solutions.
* Identify opportunities to leverage customer participation to support grid reliability, affordability, resiliency, peak demand management, and evolving system needs.
* Serve as the company's business lead for customer-facing grid modernization initiatives, ensuring alignment between customer needs, regulatory requirements, and utility operational objectives.
Build a multi-state roadmap for customer program expansion across FirstEnergy's operating companies.  

Regulatory Strategy & Program Development

* Lead development of regulatory filings, business cases, testimony support, and stakeholder engagement associated with customer programs and grid flexibility initiatives.

title: Renewable Energy Infrastructure Project Manager
description:
Puget Sound Energy is looking to grow our community with top talented individuals like you! With our rapidly growing, award winning energy efficiency programs, our pathway to an exciting and innovative future is now.

PSE's Major Projects team is looking for qualified candidates to fill an open **Renewable Energy Infrastructure Project Manager** position!

Specific details regarding the work arrangements for this position will be discussed in further detail during the interview process.

**Job Description**
-------------------

PSE is looking for an Renewable Energy Infrastructure Project Manager to oversee the development of a new solar facility in Kittitas County. In this role, the Project Manager works in conjuction with Construction Management, EPC contractors, the Energy Delivery team, and will lead the project from development handoff through commercial operation date. They will need to be diligent in providing regular project status updates, KPIs, and maintain the project budgets, schedules, forecasts, and risk registers.

The Renewable Energy Infrastructure Project Manager serves as a key representative of Puget Sound Energy with regulatory agencies, municipalities, media representatives, customers, community stakeholders, and the public. The Project Manager will be office-based in a PSE facility (hybrid schedule) but regular overnight travel to remote job sites for monthly in-person meetings will be required. Travel is estimated to be one week per month.

All PSE employees are expected to uphold the safety compliance standards inherent in PSE’s operating and/or field procedures related to work responsibilities and promote and support a culture of total safety.
